arcs.title: The Duck Bandit Chronicles
arcs.summary: Day 4: The WJES map, rotated seventeen degrees, reveals all seven duck-orientation lines converging precisely on Christine and Steve's Jeep. A new duck appeared Sunday morning wearing a burgundy waistcoat, facing northeast — completing a closed circuit. The Ministry has issued a Grade Two Purposeful Array advisory. Lucy was observed near the Jeep at 4:47 a.m. and declines to comment. The Duck Bandit appears to have been constructing a deliberate pattern pointing to this household. Day 5 (resolution) should reveal the Bandit's identity or purpose — a warm, funny payoff. Lucy's possible involvement may be confirmed or left gloriously ambiguous. The revelation should feel earned and affectionate.
